svg.title: Prisma 7 AMA: Clearing Up the Why Behind the Changes
svg.desc: A typographic question and answer from the Prisma 7 AMA: is Prisma 7 faster or slower than Prisma 6, answered with the line that it depends heavily on how you measure performance, with the operative phrase set in prism cyan. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism cyan accent.
